description: This file defines the Configuration class within the AWS SDK's EndpointDiscovery namespace. The class manages endpoint discovery configuration options such as enabling endpoint discovery and cache limit, providing methods to access these configurations and to output them as an array.

classes.name: Configuration
classes.description: Defines configuration settings for endpoint discovery in AWS SDK, including enablement status and cache limit.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes configuration with enabled flag and cache limit, validating cache limit as positive integer and enabled as boolean.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether endpoint discovery is enabled.

methods.name: getCacheLimit
methods.description: Returns the cache limit for endpoint discovery.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the configuration as an associative array.
